name: cardea-landingpage
description: Cardea landing page — static, Tailwind CSS + HTMX

scripts.vendor: mkdir -p public/assets/fonts public/assets/js && cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js public/assets/js/ && cp node_modules/@fontsource-variable/inter/files/inter-latin-wght-normal.woff2 node_modules/@fontsource/jetbrains-mono/files/jetbrains-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2 node_modules/@fontsource/jetbrains-mono/files/jetbrains-mono-latin-500-normal.woff2 node_modules/@fontsource/cormorant-sc/files/cormorant-sc-latin-500-normal.woff2 node_modules/@fontsource/cormorant-sc/files/cormorant-sc-latin-600-normal.woff2 public/assets/fonts/
scripts.build: npm run vendor && tailwindcss -i src/input.css -o public/assets/css/site.css --minify
scripts.dev: npm run vendor && (npm run watch & npm run serve)
